info.name: Sign In Solutions VMS AuditLogs Capacities API
Get the capacity details for a location

params.name: hours_to_forecast
params.description: The next N number of hours, the data needs to be calculated. Range from 1 to 24. If not set, it defaults to 8.

params.name: timestamp
params.description: ISO8601 timestamp(includes the offset value) to use as the start point for the capacity estimate report. Defaults to the current local timestamp of the location if not provided. Eg: "2020-07-16T17:05:08-07:00"

items.docs: Gets the details of the future capacity in a location.

info.name: Get the current capacity details for a location

items.docs: Get details of current capacity in a location
